findings: bulk_payment retains sender in BatchRecord but indexes only global BatchCount and Batch(id)
cross_asset_payment retains sender in PaymentRecord but indexes only global PaymentCount and Payment(id)
global-count scans would be O(global history) and read unrelated senders
one unbounded Vec per sender would violate the issue's storage/read-limit constraint
bounded per-sender ordinal-to-global-id indexing gives O(limit) listing independent of global history
cross_asset_payment records use persistent storage with PAYMENT_TTL_LEDGERS=518400, so index retention must be defined consistently
a forward-only new index does not automatically enumerate records created before contract upgrade
backend ContractEventIndexer is separate event indexing and does not satisfy contract-state enumeration

proposed_contract.index_shape: sender-local count plus sender ordinal to existing global ID
proposed_contract.complexity: O(limit) reads with a fixed contract cap
